messages.content: Since KG did OK yesterday on some city driving incl. curves up to 55 mph highway, today I'm taking it on a couple hours' drive, at least the first half of that on 70 mph highway.  Will report back.   FWIW, NNLC is on, model trained on my car plus one other '22 PHEV.   Long I didn't test as much, though will be mostly in chill mode.   Dynamic experimental yesterday it seemed good, except pretty jerky if on curves where my set speed was much above where experimental wanted to drive.   (It'd jerk starting to accelerate when flipping back to chill.)    The latter I believe has nothing to do with KG per se.

Drove as planned, mostly just straight highway.   KG did very well - no oscillation and good lane keeping.  Lane changes were smooth.   At this point it'd be my highway daily driver, but I'm not on the highway much.   City - bit different story.   Relatively more "loose" and slowly wandered/drifted a bit within the lane, usually with a slight right bias.   SP Vikander by comparison is more tight/planted and more readily exerts early torque in turns, compared to this model.   Long (experimental) in traffic I thought was good.   I switched back to SP Vikander since I drive mostly in town and <= 55 mph secondary highway.

700 mile road trip with KD in a 2019 Pre-Global Subaru Outback. Near perfect. Much improvement on what ever dev-c3 stock was. That had way too many oscillations to feel safe on the highway. 

I think I drove less than 10% of the time, including around Chicago. I just sort of set cruise and let it drive rather than worrying about jockying for position in the highway traffic.
Which branch are you on? A friend just got a C3X for his 2018 Outback.
dev-c3-new
